- tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py:55-64 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `MOCK_GH` `api` handler checks the `/git/refs/tags/promote-cycle-frozen` path twice. The first block (lines 55-60) answers every non-DELETE method, including `GET`, with `respond({})`. That makes the second block (lines 61-64) unreachable, so a GET of the freeze tag always succeeds with `{}` and never returns the exists or 404 response.
  WHY: `pin_freeze` (scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:546) takes the stale-tag cleanup path on every pinned run, so `tag_deletes` counts come out 1 higher than expected. The reviewer says 8 tests fail as a result: lines 870, 880, 917, 925, 934, 942, 952 and 960. The `elif ! is_http_404` branch (line 562) and the `frozen_at` age parse (lines 549-554) are never exercised, and `test_pinned_cycle_deletes_a_stale_tag_before_freezing` (line 888) passes for the wrong reason. The reviewer labelled this severity BLOCKER, mapped here to high.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:538-584 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: None outstanding. The reviewer checked the stale-tag cleanup (lines 538-566) and the ref-create race handling (lines 573-584) in `pin_freeze`.
  WHY: The "already exists" race calls `skip_cycle cycle_in_flight` before `PIN_TAG_CREATED` is set, so the EXIT trap cannot delete a tag another cycle owns. A ref-create failure that is not a race deletes the ref before falling back to an unpinned cycle. `comprehensive_release_cycle_freeze` is called only on terminal states. The reviewer labelled this severity NIT, mapped here to low.
